correctness.rationale: The domain r^2<(H+eps*h)/(1+H+eps*h) preserves weighted hyperbolic area exactly. Direct monomial radial integration gives lambda_n=I_u(n+1,a) and lambda_0-lambda_m=(1-u)^a B_m>0. Differentiation of the trace-class Toeplitz family in a compact subdisk, then the simple-top-eigenvalue second derivative, produces both the negative fixed-test term and the positive response sum |Tprime_m0|^2/(lambda_0-lambda_m); this gives exactly q_m. The binomial finite-sum identity P_m(u)=a*u+(1-u)*sum_{j=1}^m(m+1-j)b_j>0 proves strict ordering. An independent finite-section computation reproduced predicted 0.0677565765851 with eps-halving errors decreasing approximately fourfold, and 1380 modal grid checks; the proof, not the experiments, establishes all a,H,m.

final_claim: For every a,H>0 and every real C^2 mean-zero radial hyperbolic-area perturbation h of a fixed disk, the fully optimized weighted Bergman localization eigenvalue has diagonal second variation -a(a+1)(1+H)^(-a-2) sum_{m>=2} q_m |hhat_m|^2, q_m=1-(a+m)b_m/((a+1)B_m), b_m=(a)_m(H/(1+H))^m/m!, B_m=sum_{j=1}^m b_j. q_1=0, 0<q_2<q_3<...<1, q_m->1 and q_2=(2-u)/(2+(a+1)u), u=H/(1+H). m=2 is the uniquely sharp nontranslational direction.
limitations: Only one complex dimension, real C^2 mean-zero radial masks and fixed a,H; no rough-domain, nonlocal, higher-eigenvalue or uniform-in-frequency assertion.
